b2-tudomanyjovo-01.title: Communicative Challenge: What Did Krausz Win For?
b2-tudomanyjovo-01.scenario: At a science evening in Mór, a schoolchild asks you, a physics student, what Ferenc Krausz won the Nobel Prize for. You explain with the hummingbird comparison from the reading.
b2-tudomanyjovo-01.prompt: Tell the child what Krausz's research makes visible.
cues: Say who won the prize and in which year
Say what the light pulses make visible
Say what the researchers hope for, with a condition
b2-tudomanyjovo-01.target: Krausz Ferenc 2023-ban fizikai Nobel-díjat kapott. Az attoszekundumos fényimpulzusokkal az elektronok mozgását lehet megfigyelni, mint egy gyors vakuval a kolibri szárnycsapását. Amennyiben a módszer megbízható, a vérplazma vizsgálata segíthet a betegségek korai felismerésében.
b2-tudomanyjovo-01.english: Ferenc Krausz won the Nobel Prize in Physics in 2023. Attosecond light pulses make it possible to observe the movement of electrons, like a fast flash freezes the wingbeat of a hummingbird. If the method is reliable, examining blood plasma may help to detect diseases early.
b2-tudomanyjovo-01.canDo: I can explain Ferenc Krausz's Nobel Prize-winning research on attosecond physics and electronic motion.

b2-tudomanyjovo-02.title: Communicative Challenge: What Is ELI-ALPS?
b2-tudomanyjovo-02.scenario: A visiting student at the university in Szeged asks you, a researcher, what the ELI-ALPS centre is and how foreign researchers can work there.
b2-tudomanyjovo-02.prompt: Tell the student what ELI-ALPS is and how researchers get time to measure.
cues: Say where the centre is and what it researches
Say how researchers get measurement time
Add a condition for the applicants
b2-tudomanyjovo-02.target: Az ELI-ALPS egy lézeres kutatóközpont Szegeden, amely az ultrarövid fényimpulzusokat kutatja. A kutatók pályázat útján kaphatnak mérési időt, amennyiben a projektjük megfelel a követelményeknek.
b2-tudomanyjovo-02.english: ELI-ALPS is a laser research centre in Szeged that researches ultrashort light pulses. Researchers can get measurement time through an application, if their project meets the requirements.
b2-tudomanyjovo-02.canDo: I can describe the ELI-ALPS laser research center in Szeged as part of European research infrastructure.

b2-tudomanyjovo-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Why Is Hungarian Hard for AI?
b2-tudomanyjovo-03.scenario: A journalism student interviews you, a linguist at a research centre in Budapest, about Hungarian and artificial intelligence.
b2-tudomanyjovo-03.prompt: Tell the student why Hungarian is a challenge for language models.
cues: Say what happens to Hungarian words
Say what the word order depends on
Say what might have happened without the corpora, with volna
b2-tudomanyjovo-03.target: A magyar szavak sokféle ragozott alakot kapnak, és a szórend a fókusztól függ. Ha a nyelvészek nem építettek volna digitális korpuszokat, a magyar nyelv ma valószínűleg digitális hátrányt szenvedne.
b2-tudomanyjovo-03.english: Hungarian words take many inflected forms, and the word order depends on the focus. If linguists had not built digital corpora, Hungarian would probably suffer a digital disadvantage today.
b2-tudomanyjovo-03.canDo: I can explain the unique computational challenges Hungarian grammar poses for AI and large language models.

b2-tudomanyjovo-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Battery Plants in Debrecen
b2-tudomanyjovo-04.scenario: At a public meeting in Debrecen, a resident asks you, an engineer, what the new battery plants bring and what worries people.
b2-tudomanyjovo-04.prompt: Tell the resident what the plants promise and what worries people.
cues: Say what the plants promise the region
Say under what condition the risks can be reduced
b2-tudomanyjovo-04.target: A gyárak új munkahelyeket és mérnöki innovációt ígérnek. Az aggodalmak a vízről és a talajvíz védelméről szólnak. Abban az esetben, ha a hatóságok szigorú ellenőrzést írnak elő, a kockázatok csökkenthetők.
b2-tudomanyjovo-04.english: The plants promise new jobs and engineering innovation. The worries concern water and the protection of groundwater. If the authorities require strict checks, the risks can be reduced.
b2-tudomanyjovo-04.canDo: I can discuss the opportunities and environmental debates surrounding Hungary's battery manufacturing hubs.

b2-tudomanyjovo-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Will Hungarian Survive Online?
b2-tudomanyjovo-05.scenario: At a university seminar in Budapest, a classmate asks you whether Hungarian can keep its place in the digital age. You report what the linguists in the reading say.
b2-tudomanyjovo-05.prompt: Tell your classmate what linguists say about Hungarian in the digital age.
cues: Say what it may lose without that
b2-tudomanyjovo-05.target: A nyelvészek szerint a magyarnak digitális korpuszokra és mesterséges intelligencia eszközökre van szüksége. Amennyiben nem fektetnek be ezekbe, a nyelv fokozatosan elveszítheti a funkcióit.
b2-tudomanyjovo-05.english: According to the linguists, Hungarian needs digital corpora and artificial intelligence tools. If nobody invests in them, the language may gradually lose its functions.
b2-tudomanyjovo-05.canDo: I can discuss the future viability of medium-sized European languages like Hungarian in a digitized world.

b2-tudomanyjovo-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Science Week in Szeged
b2-tudomanyjovo-consolidation.scenario: At the end of a science week in Szeged, a visitor asks you to tell two things you have learned about Hungarian science and language technology.
b2-tudomanyjovo-consolidation.prompt: Tell the visitor two things you learned this week.
cues: Say what might have happened without digital corpora
Add a condition about the future
b2-tudomanyjovo-consolidation.target: Szegeden lézeres kutatóközpont működik. Ha a nyelvészek nem építettek volna korpuszokat, a magyar nyelv ma digitális hátrányt szenvedne. Amennyiben most is befektetnek, a nyelv életképes marad.
b2-tudomanyjovo-consolidation.english: There is a laser research centre in Szeged. If linguists had not built corpora, Hungarian would suffer a digital disadvantage today. If they keep investing, the language stays viable.
b2-tudomanyjovo-consolidation.canDo: I can synthesize the trajectory of 21st-century Hungarian science from attosecond physics to large language models.
